description: Call BEFORE your agent signs or sends anything from a wallet. Decodes a transaction, an EIP-712 typed-data request (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 USDC authorizations, Seaport orders), an EIP-7702 delegation or an x402 payment (402 terms + payload) into plain English and returns SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER with risk flags (unlimited approvals, setApprovalForAll, fake USDC domains, x402 overpay or wrong payTo, OFAC SDN counterparties). Free preview tier (offline). The paid x402 endpoint /v1/check adds reasons, on-chain facts (spender is a wallet or contract, token metadata) and an eth_call simulation.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, base-sepolia or a chain id

payment_payload.description: x402 payment you are about to send: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT (base64) or JSON

payment_required.description: x402 402 terms: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) or JSON {accepts:[…]}

typed_data.description: EIP-712 request {domain, types, primaryType, message} as passed to eth_signTypedData_v4

name: check_signature
title: Is it safe to sign this?
